heading: Monetary and Fiscal Policies Co-ordination and SBP Autonomy
title: Monetary and Fiscal Policies Co-ordination and SBP Autonomy
text: The Bank shall be an autonomous body having the primary objective of maintaining domestic price stability, and without prejudice to price stability, supporting the economic policies of the Federal Government to foster development and fuller utilization of productive resources.
text_raw: The Bank shall be an autonomous body having the primary objective of maintaining domestic price stability, and without prejudice to price stability, supporting the economic policies of the Federal Government to foster development and fuller utilization of productive resources.

heading: Business which the Bank may transact
title: Business which the Bank may transact
text: The Bank is authorized to carry on and transact several kinds of business, including the issuing of notes, acceptance of deposits from banks and Government, purchase and rediscount of bills of exchange, and regulation of credit and liquidity in the banking system.
